# DentX Dental Lab

> Digital dental laboratory in Tarzana, California, serving dental offices across the San Fernando Valley and Los Angeles. Free pickup and delivery, complimentary shade matching, digital cases accepted from Medit, iTero, Shining 3D and DEXIS IOS Cloud, or by STL.

- Legal name: DentX Dental Lab Inc
- Address: 18401 Burbank Blvd #110, Tarzana, CA 91356
- Phone: +1 (818) 687-0085
- Email: Dentxdentallab@yahoo.com
- Audience: dentists and dental office managers (not patients)

- Acrylic full denture: bite block 6, teeth try-in 7, final finish 7 days; $180

- Valplast: bite block 6, teeth try-in 7, final finish 12 days; $230

- Acrylic stayplate: 4 days, $95 per arch up to 3 units, $110 for 4+ units
- Printed flexible stayplate: 4 days, $85 per arch

- Night guard (hard or soft): 3 days, $85
